name: Lewis
quote: The girl's heart hidden behind the toys.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: (Yawn) Good morning, Professor... Ah, is it this late already? I'll go prepare for work right now! Eh? Wait a minute, where did my hat go...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: My building block sword looks super cute, right? ...You're asking if it's heavy? No, not at all! See, it's so light... Aiiiieee! A block just fell off!

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It feels great to have dinner with you, Professor. Now then, we ought to get back to work after resting... Hm? Now that you mention it, which pile has the bills and which pile has the files?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: It's time to sleep, Professor. Just relax and leave the rest to me! Don't worry, I'm super reliable!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text:
Is Doggy No. 1 there?
<color=#EB34AE>Arf, arf! Doggy No. 1 is here!</color>
Ehehehe, aren't these toys really cute? Since we've got the opportunity, why don't we do a little roleplay?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Professor! Come look! These are all toys I made, from their aesthetics all the way to their mechanical engineering. Surprising, right? Did any of them catch your eye? I can give them to you!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor... Are you asleep? Let's see, where's the blanket...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Leave the heavy stuff to me! I won't lose when it comes to strength!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Ehehe, that tickles, Professor~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Kyaaaa... That feels... so breezy...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Eh?! How come I'm all tied up! Mmmh... Nnn... I can't break free... C'mon Professor, help!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: (Groan) Say, can I send Tin Soldier No. 1 in my place?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Pan paka pan~ This is Lewis, the toy designer, at the head of a company of tin soldiers! Eh? That's strange. Where did everyone go? Professor, please help me!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: New building blocks get~

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Don't look down on the power of toys~

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Welcome to the world of fairytales, built of toys!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Everyone, it's playtime!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Leave the fighting to me~

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: It's toy time!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Ehehehe, well done, me!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Don't look down on my strength, okay?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: My toys... they're broken...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Wow, what a beautiful gift this is... eh? This is the proof of an oath? Hehe, no wonder your expression was so cute, Professor~
Though I can't help but feel that what you're saying sounds familiar. It must be something I projected in my dollhouse while simulating an oath scenario... Uwahhhh, y-you heard all of that? Wow, that's embarrassing... Never imagined that... all that stuff I thought up would become reality. Well, could you help me put on that proof I've been expecting so much?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor! New Year at the Oasis sure is lively! If you don't have anything planned, want to go browse a toy store with me? There are lots of new and highly collectible toys on sale today! Oh yes, let's go see the fireworks after our visit!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Professor, this is my Valentine's Day chocolate for you~
<color=#EB34AE>Hahaha, thank you, Lewis, you really are the best after all!</color>
Mhm, now I'm ready... W-Wait a minute, P-Professor, when did you come in?!
...Eh? I really am the best after—Professor! Quit making fun of me with my own lines!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: (Sob) The story of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl is so romantic. The magpies are great too, forming a bridge in the heavens that crosses the Milky Way and all... Alright, I've made up my mind! I'll build a bridge of building blocks to help ease the burden of the magpies! ...Huh? So it's a myth, Professor? Aw... But that's okay! If we ever get separated one day, I'll build a bridge over to your side!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Come look, come look! This jack-o'-lantern I designed is really cute, right? These little horror-themed accessories are always super popular come Halloween. I've decided on my makeup and costume for tonight. Naturally, I've got an outfit for you too, Professor~ Hehe, let's go join the trick-or-treaters!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: This smart Rubik's Cube is for Miss Hannah... Hm? Professor, what are you doing here? Hang on, I've got a lot of stuff here... Owie, owie, ouch. Ehehehe, sorry about that, Professor. I was wrapping gifts for everyone. Hm? No, it's not stressful at all. When I think about the looks of surprise on everyone's faces, all the hard work I put in will have paid off. Ah! That's right, I've already wrapped your gift~ Merry Christmas, Professor!!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: I won't forget your birthday, Professor! I've been looking forward to this day for a loooooong time now, and I can finally give you this gift! Tadaaaah~ I designed this toy myself~ How is it? Cute, isn't it? By the way, I also have the next year's present in mind~

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Tadaaah! This is my specially made apple pie! What do you think, Professor? Doesn't it look good? Here, Professor, I'll feed you some. Open your mouth and go nom~ Hehe, how does it taste? Um... Professor, why does your face look so weird?
...Hm? The ingredients? Oh, candied apples, cinnamon... Ah, and 15 ladles of corn flour to get it to look just right~ Huh? Professor? Stay with me, Professor!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Did you know, Professor? Toys are an expression of how their designers are still young at heart~ I can't help but smile whenever children hold toys like they're treasures. Mhm~ They really are better off in a toybox than behind shopfront windows. Hehe, makes me want to make toys that'll bring a smile to your face, Professor~

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: I once picked up a plush doll on the battlefield. It had stitches where it had been fixed and its stuffing had been well-worn. Clearly, its owner had loved it very much. I'm sure it must have wanted to go back to its owner too. That's why, to this day, I've been taking care of it in its owner's place. I'm sure that someday, it will return to its owner's side and keep them company, just like... just like how I'm keeping you company too, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Toys are treasures for kids and gifts for adults. Building blocks, stuffy dolls, models... Everyone likes different kinds of toys. Do you have any toys that you like, Professor? ...Huh? You like anything I make? W-Well, that's nice to hear. In that case, want to design a toy with me next time?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
To many people, toys are childish and things that adults ought to discard. (Sigh) That notion plagued me for a time. I thought and thought, but I just couldn't figure out how to proceed. 
However, I've arrived at a solution! Liking toys has nothing to do with your age. If you like them, then you can enjoy your encounters with your toys whenever you want! Isn't that right?
<color=#EB34AE>Yup yup, isn't that the truth!</color>
Hehe~ You taught me that, Professor. Therefore, please continue staying by my side from now on, Professor~

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: Ah, got it!

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Indeed!

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Ehehe~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Uwaaah!

voices.label: Special Affection 1
voices.text: Ehhhh?!

career:
The E-TD is a specially-made Doll from Universal Anything Services dedicated to the design and development of toys and other collectibles. Initially, the E-TD and its advanced modules were used for the reproduction of specific styles of toys in order to meet the various needs of collectors. However, the designers soon discovered that it also performed very well in novel toy manufacturing, and its products were very well received by children. As such, production and sales volumes were similarly scaled up.

Due to an unfortunate accident when she was being rolled out, Lewis' physical power output ended up being about 50% higher than other E-TDs, but this so-called defect ended up being her unique talent. Her extremely fine control over her strength ended up granting greater insight into child ergonomics, allowing her to better demonstrate her creativity and inspiration while combining them with both safety and fun in mind. As a result, Lewis received excellent market feedback and was chosen to join Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
After taking into consideration the extremely high standards certain collectors had for Victorian and Edwardian-era aesthetics, the design team for the E-TD made the decision to furnish its database with large quantities of information on the subject. Post-rollout feedback indicated that this decision managed to fulfill the requirements of that particular clientele, but it also affected the aesthetic sense of the Dolls themselves.

Lewis can make all kinds of toys, from intricate little tin soldiers to 1/18th scale steam locomotives. She has but to observe and hold them once to faithfully reproduce their every detail. In addition, her works include a healthy dose of her personal flair; as a big fan of this retro style, she loves intricate little decorations, and often adds large amounts of ribbons and medals to the dolls she makes, to the point where it's become something akin to a personal trademark.

There was little in the way of standards and regulations in the early toy market, and many items that would later be classified as dangerous were often mixed into them, leading to frequent cases of child injury. That was until the E-TD arrived to help alleviate the situation. Their toys, which were produced after massive amounts of data collection and analysis, were not only attractive but also incorporated soft materials on their edges to minimize any risk to children during play. The E-TDs' safety standards for children's toys remains a market benchmark. 

Lewis' love for toys was often expressed in her daily work. She personally participated and supervised the production process of even ordinary toys, personally removing ripple defects and mold lines to make every single one of her creations as perfect as possible. Her exquisite workmanship, combined with the marketing blurb of "dolls designed by Dolls," made Lewis' creations very popular. In addition, endorsement from a certain hardcore collector caused the prices of her toys to surge in secondary markets, and she became the darling of people both inside and outside the industry.

When Lewis makes toys, she doesn't just consider their design, but also who their future owner might be. For personal reasons which are difficult to disclose, Lewis often visited an orphanage where she would give the toys she made to the kids there. Even though she did not charge anything for said toys, she crafted them in accordance to her personal, highest standards, making each child a toy that was uniquely theirs.

Many collectors have lamented this practice, comparing it to casting pearls before swine. While publicly condemning her actions, they secretly repurchased them from those kids before reselling them at high prices. Upon learning about such actions, Lewis chose to seclude herself in her home for several months. As discussion about her self-imposed exile began circulating in the media, she flooded the market with large quantities of the products she had made during that time and actively disclosed the techniques which had gone into making them. This turned what had once been nigh-priceless collectors' items into ordinary toys which anyone could afford, leading to the downfall of those greedy collectors who hoarded her creations for profit.

"You can't call it charity if you're expecting something in return."

The early days of being trapped in the cloud were not to Lewis' preferences. After awakening, she realized that the stone-cold concrete jungle around her was in no way connected to her beloved toys. While she could use operand manipulation to make up for a shortfall of materials and tools, there was no way to compensate for her missing audience. For the agents who lived in the cloud, Lewis' toys were worthless and a waste of resources, which forced her to stop creating them. After spending some time in low spirits, Lewis was surprised to find that the toys she had made to pass the time were surprisingly popular among the little agents in the Burbank Sector, and many of them looked her up to ask them about the toys' origins and the principles behind them. This reignited Lewis' passion for toy design and she soon took up her mantle again, devoting herself to crafting toys that were unique to the cloud.

However, this beautiful dream was crushed by the Entropization of Magrasea. When she saw a pair of little hands sticking out of a pile of rubble, holding one of her creations, she felt utterly powerless for the first time. Then, she took up arms, wielding sword and shield to protect the owners of the toys she had made.

"It isn't enough to just bring them happiness. What I want is to protect the smiles on those kids' faces when they hold their toys."

After joining the Oasis, Lewis still makes toys every day. Her works are universally well-received in the Oasis, and many Dolls favor them. The most popular ones are Professor-shaped dolls, which replicates their appearance faithfully and features cute little ribbons. Such toys have become commonplace in the Oasis and are slowly being sold to other sectors.

Lewis is not particularly concerned with remuneration. The proceeds of her sales have gone toward rebuilding the sectors, and she maintains her habit of distributing free toys to juvenile agents. At Lewis' insistence, her creations are all sold at the minimum price, and if a cute-looking kid pleads with her nicely, she will give away all the toys on her without hesitation.
oathDesc: Filled with her passion and ingenuity, inside and out.

projections.name: Emissary of the Obsidian Blade
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
""A holy blade hewn from mahogany stone, only wieldable by a chosen hero—or that's how the story goes! The story! But even if it's just a toy, waving it around still takes some serious effort!""

projections.name: Lord of Wonderfort
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
""I am the one and only—great Lord of Wonderfort, Countess of the Toyblock Knights, the dazzler of children far and wide, the WEAVER OF DREAMS!""

skinList.name: Midnight Carmine Theater
skinList.desc:
A glamorous magician clad in a dark red dress, mustering the attention of all present at the gala with her smile, passion, and bold inspiration. Then, allow us to respond to her and her army of toys with applause and cheer.
"What a busy, busy night! When the genius puppet magician takes the stage, everything that night shall be under her command—who else but myself, of course! Come up to the stage, Professor, if you would please!"
